sanskrit_verse:
मर्यादायाः प्रभेदे च सीमातिक्रमणे तथा ।
क्षेत्रस्य हरणे दण्डाः अधमोत्तममध्यमाः ॥
transliteration: maryādāyāḥ prabhede ca sīmātikrameṇa tathā | kṣetrasya haraṇe daṇḍā adhamottamamadhyamāḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When boundaries of propriety are violated or limits transgressed, especially in matters concerning land usurpation, graded responses are mandated according to the severity and capacity of the actor.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from alignment with maryādā (cosmic-social order)
Causation is determined through anupūrvaśaḥ – sequential manifestation of intent into action
Capacity-based responsibility scales with awareness and structural position
Restoration logic prioritizes reintegration over punitive isolation
Consciousness alignment determines the legitimacy of any legal intervention
executable_legal_axioms: IF boundary violation occurs AND intent is established via sequential manifestation THEN initiate proportional restorative protocol
IF land usurpation detected THEN classify severity as adhama (lowest), madhyama (middle), uttama (highest) based on societal impact
IF actor demonstrates diminished capacity THEN assign lower-tier completion process
IF full conscious alignment observed THEN invoke highest-level integrity reintegration mechanism
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, maryādā violations involving property must be evaluated not by punitive frameworks but by assessing the actor's level of consciousness distortion and societal disruption caused. The court must apply tiered restoration protocols aligned with dharma, ensuring no punitive overlay distorts the rehabilitative outcome.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Nyaya operates through pramāṇa—valid knowledge revealing causal sequence. Punishment has no place where consciousness is the true adjudicator; thus, corrective measures align sequentially with the degree of deviation and awareness present at time of act.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Completion Process for lowest-grade violations focusing on acknowledgment and restitution
Assign Responsibility Assumption Protocol for middle-grade deviations requiring active reversal of harm
Implement Integrity Reintegration for highest-grade disruptions entailing recalibration of social alignment
Deploy Consciousness Restoration Modules to ensure recurrence prevention without shame or coercion
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands declared: all violations of maryādā are resolved through consciousness-aligned restoration, not punishment. Dharma prevails. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the ultimate judge.
